def ycols(frame):
    r=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return [(i,j) for i in range(64) for j in range(64) if r[i][j]=='Y']
def greens(frame):
    seg=frame.segmentation;g=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary'];g.append((min(p[0] for p in b),max(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),max(p[1] for p in b)))
    return sorted(g)
print('before Y',ycols(current_frame),'ngreens',len(greens(current_frame)))
r=action(['RIGHT'])
print('after Y',ycols(current_frame),'ngreens',len(greens(current_frame)),r.get('board_changed'),r.get('no_impact'))
la=last_animation;e=la[-1]
for k,f in enumerate(e.frames):
    rr=f.ascii.split('\n')
    ys=[(i,j) for i in range(64) for j in range(64) if rr[i][j]=='Y']
    print('anim',k,ys)
</parameter>
</function>
